messages:
Alex: Lantern Finance wants to migrate from CompetitorX -> Redwood. They want a 2-week POC for parity, cost delta, and security. Can we outline plan + blockers?
Morgan: Parity surface: request/response schema, defaults (temp/top_p), streaming shape, embeddings hashing, error codes, rate limits.
Sam: Pricing ask: they currently bill per-request; worried about per-token variability. We should give a POC estimate (100k tokens/day peak).
Meera: Security questions incoming: KMS/HSM, data residency, logs retention, access controls, SOC2. Lantern is finance so KMS + VPC expected.
Chris: Proposal: compatibility shim + header mapping. Example curl to keep client changes small:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compat/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Compat-Source: competitor_x" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<text>","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.7}'
```
Note: CompetitorX tokenization differs; expect ~5-12% token variance.
Morgan: I'll draft a 50-prompt parity suite (short/long/multi-turn/injection/system-role) and an eval harness. Lantern can run locally or we run hosted.
Sam: For POC pricing: offer discounted hosted rate or Dedicated trial credits. I'll model per-token vs per-request and share numbers.
Meera: For compliance, recommend Dedicated in-region with customer-managed KMS for POC to satisfy SOC2/finance needs. On-prem/VPC lengthens timeline.
Alex: Any enterprise blockers? IP, hallucination SLAs, fallback?
Morgan: We can add wrapper filters for hallucination and deterministic-seed note: Redwood sampling differs unless seed provided. Canary rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with fallback to CompetitorX.
Chris: Streaming mismatch: they expect ndjson chunks, we stream framed events. We'll add a small adaptor: repackage chunks into ndjson.
Meera: Lantern asked about pen-test windows and indemnities. I'll open legal ticket and attach standard answers.
security-bot: Standard security Qs uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sec/qna-lantern-v1.pdf :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll own the one-pager for the kickoff and send pricing appendix. Scheduling call with Lantern infra/security on Monday.
Alex: Actions: Morgan -> parity suite + harness (Thu). Chris -> shim + stream adaptor sample (Wed). Sam -> pricing + one-pager (Mon). Meera -> security questionnaire + legal ticket (Wed). Post status updates here.
Chris: I'll push a tiny repo with shim example and tests and link here when ready.
Sam: Draft one-pager will include parity goals, timeline, pricing scenarios, and open security items.
Alex: Thanks all.
